g.text: Auto Ontology pod lifecycle
Not fetched
Source at the pinned commit
Image built (localhost/auto-ontology)
Pod up (Postgres, migrated backend, ingestion
loopback only)
Fixture database demo.orders present
2048-dim embedder serving and demo.orders embedded
A question answered over demo.orders (semantic layer compiled)
cmd: just ao-fetch | pass: prints 'ao-fetch: verified at 2a24f5d3...'; any other commit exits 1
cmd: just ao-build | pass: prints 'ao-build: done' (or 'image already exists, skipping'), exit 0
cmd: just ao-up | pass: prints 'ao-up: both endpoints healthy after N s'; refuses with exit 1 unless just retrieval-up is serving on 8081 and 8082
cmd: just ao-smoke | pass: two PASS lines (backend 127.0.0.1:13001, ingestion 127.0.0.1:13002) and exit 0
cmd: just ao-status | pass: both lines read 'http 200'
cmd: just ao-fixture | pass: prints 'ao-fixture: demo.orders rows=5', exit 0
cmd: just ao-down | pass: podman pod ps lists no auto-ontology pod; ports 13001 and 13002 are free
cmd: just ao-down | pass: podman pod ps lists no auto-ontology pod; ports 13001 and 13002 are free

cmd: just embed2048-up | pass: prints 'embed2048-up: ready'; an embeddings call returns a vector of length 2048; ingestion logs show the rows embedded (Qwen Research License, non-commercial: NOTICE.md)
cmd: just ao-enable-semantic | pass: prints 'ao-enable-semantic: semantic_compilation_enabled=true' (the opt-in flag the absent frontend would have written)
cmd: just ao-ask-check | pass: prints 'semantic-status' finishing, then 'PASS ao-ask: the model wrote SQL, the database returned 5'
cmd: just ao-down | pass: podman pod ps lists no auto-ontology pod; ports 13001 and 13002 are free
